summaries.Romania: Romania's political and economic landscape faces mounting pressures: a major corruption investigation reveals a €1M money trail linked to a Latvian bank, while energy company Getica faces insolvency after nuclear plant shutdowns force customer price hikes. Budget deficit tensions escalated as PM Niculescu skipped parliamentary questioning.

The sector grapples with responsible AI deployment and equity in treatment access.
summaries.Tech: Apple's ecosystem expands with new iPad models incoming in 2027, HomeView gains security camera features, and the broader tech world confronts major security threats including North Korea's record $6.3B Binance heist and increasing competition in foldable phones. AI-driven infrastructure and privacy concerns dominate ongoing discussions.

items.title: North Korea linked to massive Binance crypto heist
items.snippet: The FBI says North Korea was behind the massive $6.3 billion crypto heist that hit Binance on October 29th.
